shots.label: 종이 무대를 찢는 인형 거인
shots.prompt:
Create ONE 16:9 landscape concept artwork for an interactive theatrical exhibition. The supplied image is an EDIT / REDESIGN reference for the red city, tiny inhabitants and giant-invader premise. MAKE TWO MAJOR CHANGES: 1) replace the deep volumetric miniature architecture with a distinctly 2.5D THEATRE of flat scenic cutouts on clearly separated shallow planes; 2) COMPLETELY REPLACE THE PHOTOGRAPHIC WOMAN WITH AN ORIGINAL STYLIZED THREE-DIMENSIONAL PUPPET CHARACTER. Absolutely no photographic human face, skin, hands or realistic portrait anywhere.
Art direction: the uncanny mixed-media witch-labyrinth theatrical mood of Puella Magi Madoka Magica. Experimental paper-collage animation aesthetics, vintage etchings, rough screenprinted graphic surfaces, mismatched materials, distorted playful scale. A knowingly artificial frontal proscenium stage, cropped scalloped scarlet stage curtains along top and sides, visible thin suspension threads for a few paper doors and crescent props, a narrow footlight strip across front. Five or six FLAT rectangular apartment facade cutouts overlap with small visible gaps and sharp cast shadows, stairways are printed zigzag silhouettes on thin red boards rather than fully modeled stairs. Red/scarlet, ink-black void, ivory doors; tiny icy-blue accents on creatures. Strange stencil eyes and a few checkerboard scraps can decorate the wings sparingly. The shallow stage depth and flat surface layering must be unmistakable: illustrated outlines and thin cut edges visible. Not a realistic city, not architectural visualization, not an elaborate 3D diorama.
MAIN GIANT CHARACTER consistent design: an adult feminine theatrical trickster PUPPET, oversized angular ivory papier-mache head, sculpted short ink-black bob in chunky carved shapes, tiny dark crown-like hair clip, huge graphic black oval eyes with small icy-blue pupils, asymmetrical vermilion painted cheeks, small mischievous smile, rounded jointed ivory doll hands, black velvet puff-sleeved costume with ivory scalloped collar and one narrow blue ribbon at neck. Face and hands have clearly SCULPTED VOLUME and soft directional shadows, visible painted wood/papier-mache surface, toy-like stylized proportions. Slightly strange stop-motion doll, no realistic anatomy, no human likeness, no generic glossy Pixar princess. This big 3D puppet emerges from behind or tears through the flat city stage backdrop. It is vastly larger than the residents.
Tiny residents retain rounded ivory bean bodies, stubby limbs, black dot eyes and blue ribbon scarves, finger-sized compared with giant puppet. They appear as small flat or shallow relief paper puppets, distressed paper texture, expressive silhouettes. Whimsical mischief and slightly unsettling theatrical tension. No gore or realistic injury. No words, captions, logo, watermark, split panels, game interface, camera equipment or gallery audience. One beautifully art-directed wide stage shot with strong readable action. ACTION / COMPOSITION: full frontal wide master shot with entire proscenium visible and balanced but not rigid symmetry. The enormous 3D trickster puppet behind the set pulls apart TWO ragged flat red paper backdrops with both round jointed hands. Its ivory sculpted face emerges high in the middle of a black opening, looking downward mischievously. Visible white ripped fibers and red paper flaps curl toward camera. Four flat city wings and printed stair silhouettes remain standing in front of the puppet, clearly occluding its lower body. Tiny residents stand along two thin horizontal bridge boards and front platform, some fleeing toward ivory doors. Red hanging door prop off-center, small graphic moon suspended on a thread, restrained paper eye silhouettes at stage edges. Crisp footlight shadows, dramatic top spotlight, grainy collage surfaces. The environment should look like a cut-paper theatre viewed from its audience, puppet is its only large fully modeled 3D figure.
